list.snippet: Take the test as soon as possible after exposure if you have symptoms.
If you don't have symptoms, wait at least 5 days after exposure.
Take the test as soon as possible after exposure, regardless of symptoms.
If you have a negative test result but still experience symptoms, it's recommended to retest after a few days.
